title: Malicious code in httpnex (PyPI)
description: The httpnex package on PyPI is a malicious clone of a popular library that includes code to fetch and execute remote payloads. Upon import, it attempts to inject malicious code into local files and runs a background thread to periodically check for updated payloads. During analysis, the command and control server did not deliver the payload. This package is identified as malware due to its intent to execute remote malicious scripts.
